title: Construction of 20,000 liters capacity Under Ground Water Sump at Ramayapatnam Lighthouse Station
summary: Two-cover online e-tender for building a 20,000 litre underground RCC water sump at Ramayapatnam Lighthouse Station, Prakasam District, Andhra Pradesh, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Ramayapatnam Lighthouse Station, Ramayapatnam village & Post, Ulavapadu Mandal, Prakasam District - 523291
sites.work: Construction of 20,000 litre underground water sump

scope.item: Construction of 20,000 liters capacity Under Ground Water Sump

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening; EMD exemption (NSIC/MSME) expressly not allowed for any bidder. Tender fee Nil.

period.completion: 03 months from the commencement of work
period.bid_validity: 120 days from date of opening of financial bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD, State PWD, Railways, MES, BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last seven years: three >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; similar works = RCC works for underground sump or any other civil construction works
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel for supervision with qualifications and experience
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V) and tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV)
Income tax returns for last three years
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping or DLL
Average annual turnover of last three financial years at least 30% of estimated cost
Activity chart / plan and self-assessing technical evaluation sheet
notes: Only Section I NIT (printed 'Page 3 of 105' to 'Page 7 of 105') is posted; the remaining ~100 pages of the bid document including BOQ are not in this file. NIT dated 20/12/2022; download/submission 20/12/2022 18:00 to 05/01/2023 15:00; EMD original by 05/01/2023 15:00; bid opening 06/01/2023 16:00. Clause 1.15 notes heavy vehicles permitted to site and contractor liable for damage to pathway tiles/paver blocks/plants.
